mapper.select: SELECT COMMONCODE_NUMBER AS code , CODENAME_1 AS name , CODENAME_2 AS type , UNIT_PRICE AS price , CONTRIBUTION , CASE WHEN NVL(CONTRIBUTION, 0) < NVL(UNIT_PRICE, 0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS coverageYn , USED FROM COMMONCODE WHERE COMMONCODE = 'P' AND USED = 'Y' ORDER BY COMMONCODE_NUMBER
SELECT USED FROM COMMONCODE WHERE COMMONCODE_NUMBER = #{code} AND COMMONCODE = 'P'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commoncode ( commoncode_number, commoncode, joint_code_group_name, codename_1, codename_2, unit_price, used, contribution ) VALUES ( #{code}, 'P', '물리치료', #{name}, #{type}, #{price}, 'Y', #{contribution} )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMONCODE SET USED = 'N' WHERE COMMONCODE_NUMBER = #{code} AND COMMONCODE = 'P' AND USED = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT commoncode_number as code , codename_1 as name , codename_2 as type , unit_price as price , contribution , CASE WHEN nvl(contribution, 0) < nvl(unit_price, 0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as coverageYn , used FROM commoncode WHERE commoncode = 'P' AND used = 'N' ORDER BY commoncode_number
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMONCODE SET USED = 'Y' WHERE COMMONCODE_NUMBER = #{code} AND COMMONCODE = 'P' AND USED = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT b.BED_CODE , b.THERAPY_TYPE , b.BED_STATUS , r.treatment_number , to_char(r.TREATMENT_END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') as endTime , m.member_name as patientName , r.treatment_item_name FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_BED b LEFT JOIN physicaltherapist_records r ON b.bed_code = r.bed_code AND r.treatment_status = '치료중' LEFT JOIN receptionist_register rr ON r.medical_number = rr.medical_number LEFT JOIN member m ON rr.member_number = m.member_number ORDER BY b.BED_CODE

SELECT r.TREATMENT_NUMBER , r.MEDICAL_NUMBER , r.THERAPY_TYPE AS therapyCategory , r.TREATMENT_STATUS AS status , r.TREATMENT_ITEM_NAME AS therapyItems , TO_CHAR(rr.RECEIPT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS receiptTime , m.MEMBER_NAME AS name , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS birthDate , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('2','4','6','8') THEN '여' ELSE '남' END AS gender , doc.MEMBER_NAME AS doctorName , dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS specialization
, CASE WHEN r.TREATMENT_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND r.TREATMENT_END_TIME IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND((r.TREATMENT_END_TIME - r.TREATMENT_START_TIME) * 24 * 60) ELSE NULL END AS durationMin , CASE WHEN r.TREATMENT_STATUS = '대기' THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.THERAPY_TYPE, r.TREATMENT_STATUS ORDER BY rr.RECEIPT_DATE, r.TREATMENT_NUMBER) ELSE NULL END AS sequence FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS r JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr ON rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER = r.MEDICAL_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.MEMBER_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER doc ON doc.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON e.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT dept ON dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE r.TREATMENT_STATUS IN ('대기', '치료중') AND rr.RECEIPT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND rr.RECEIPT_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 ORDER BY r.THERAPY_TYPE, sequence NULLS LAST, r.TREATMENT_NUMBER
SELECT THERAPY_TYPE , TREATMENT_STATUS , MEDICAL_NUMBER FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS WHERE TREATMENT_NUMBER =#{treatmentNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS SET TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료중' , BED_CODE = #{bedCode} , TREATMENT_START_TIME = SYSDATE , TREATMENT_END_TIME = SYSDATE + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{durationMin}, 'MINUTE') WHERE TREATMENT_NUMBER = #{treatmentNumber} AND TREATMENT_STATUS = '대기'
UPDATE PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS SET TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료완료' , TREATMENT_END_TIME = SYSDATE , DATE_OF_TREATMENT = SYSDATE WHERE TREATMENT_NUMBER = #{treatmentNumber} AND TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료중'
UPDATE PHYSICALTHERAPIST_BED SET BED_STATUS = '사용가능' WHERE BED_CODE = (SELECT BED_CODE FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS WHERE TREATMENT_NUMBER = #{treatmentNumber}) AND BED_STATUS = '사용중'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'N') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND INJECTED_YN = 'N') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND TREATMENT_STATUS != '치료완료') FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER SET RECEIPT_STATUS = '수납대기' WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND RECEIPT_STATUS = '진료완료'
mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS d WHERE d.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND d.TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료완료' ) AS receivedCount , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS d WHERE d.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND d.TREATMENT_NUMBER <= NVL(#{treatmentNumber}, d.TREATMENT_NUMBER) ) AS courseSeq , ( SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(d.DATE_OF_TREATMENT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS d WHERE d.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND d.TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료완료' ) AS lastTreatmentDate , pm.MEMBER_PHONE_NUMBER , doc.MEMBER_NAME AS doctorName , dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS specialization FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr LEFT JOIN MEMBER doc ON doc.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON e.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT dept ON dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE = e.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MEMBER pm ON pm.MEMBER_NUMBER = rr.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber}

SELECT TO_CHAR( NVL(r.DATE_OF_TREATMENT, r.TREATMENT_START_TIME), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS treatmentDate , r.TREATMENT_ITEM_NAME , r.THERAPY_TYPE , r.TREATMENT_STATUS FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS r JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr ON rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER = r.MEDICAL_NUMBER WHERE rr.MEMBER_NUMBER = ( SELECT MEMBER_NUMBER FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} ) AND r.TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료완료' ORDER BY r.TREATMENT_NUMBER DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT THERAPY_TYPE , ROUND(AVG( (TREATMENT_END_TIME - TREATMENT_START_TIME) * 24 * 60 )) AS avgMin FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS WHERE TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료완료' AND TREATMENT_START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND TREATMENT_END_TIME IS NOT NULL AND (TREATMENT_END_TIME - TREATMENT_START_TIME) * 1440 BETWEEN 1 AND 60 GROUP BY THERAPY_TYPE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료중'
